description: Delay every old-leader outbound link after a fully drained empty-log setup. Origin node 2 sends a real tagged append 101 to leader 1; its actual Assigned reply and replication messages remain queued. Nodes 2 and 3 prepare a higher ballot excluding node 1, then decide replacement 202. Release the entire FIFO 1->2 and observe append_notify completion and the live decided suffix at its returned one-based position. No fabricated messages, source substitutions, crashes or storage faults.

harness.description: Three real OmniPaxos nodes and three real ActorState loops, driven through public APIs. Caller-owned per-link FIFO queues implement partitions and delay. Real tokio task/time primitives implement the public AsyncRuntime trait. Core prefix is initialized with explicit try_become_leader and drained before spawning actors. Runtime and protocol ticks remain enabled; large legal election/resend thresholds avoid unrelated election churn during the short controlled history. Bounded event/outgoing channels are continually drained. The result event is absent if the operation remains pending in the observation window.
semantic_changes: No target changes. Custom AsyncRuntime delegates directly to tokio spawn and sleep because selected crate default features need not expose TokioRuntime.
Caller transport replaces network I/O with FIFO queues, holding all old leader outbound messages then releasing only link 1->2 in original order.

Read observations are public API copies of the actual local decided log. Assigned positions are prefix lengths: returned k is compared at zero-based read index k-1, as established by append_tracked accepted_after.

legality.derivation: Public core and actor construction, takeover, append and transport APIs supply all producer calls. Initialization requires all three nodes report leader 1 in Accept with zero accepted/decided entries and empty transport queues. After setup, all links originating at node 1 are deferred before the request, so its 101 cannot enter the new quorum; a genuine emitted AcceptDecide confirms local acceptance. Node 2 sends TaggedProposal before its route to node 1 closes. Nodes 2 and 3 remain mutually connected and form their own real quorum. Actual Assigned is retained unchanged. Changing transport policy never reorders within a directed link. Large timer thresholds are valid configuration, not disabled code. The test has one admitted target operation, no synthesized assignments and no private state access.
legality.applicability: Successful in-memory storage, batch size 1, one fixed valid configuration with three unique node IDs. Setup and replacement prerequisites are assertions/events, not inferred from test PASS.
unresolved: The selected runtime crate requires its own trusted compilation preparation; build failures are not protocol results.

grounding.derivation: Observe the return of the exact append_notify future that generated the captured tagged EntryId; independently read the decided entry at the returned position. Error outcomes are allowed by the implication. Missing completion remains unknown.
grounding.applicability: Admitted operation in the recorded fixed-configuration history with genuine assignment, replacement decided state and completed future; success requires same proposed entry, errors are permitted.

observable_properties.description: If this admitted append_notify returns Ok, the actual decided value at that returned position equals the proposed value. A different replacement value is forbidden; Timeout/Superseded does not violate the condition.

uncertainties: Only one fixed delayed-assignment history, no exhaustive interleavings or durability claims.
Bounded pending is not a liveness violation and does not count as a completed comparison.
New crate preparation may expose compilation prerequisites; semantic attribution requires current checker correspondence after execution.
